name: vibe-lingo
description: Work-first multilingual coaching, evidence tracking, and private review scheduling for Synergy

versions.changelog: First official Plugin API 4 release with multilingual coaching, selected-text translation, evidence tracking, and private review scheduling.

featuresSummary.title: Save a correction
featuresSummary.description: Shows the correction in the conversation and saves it as learning evidence when coaching is active.

featuresSummary.title: Show learning progress
featuresSummary.description: Summarizes practice, recurring patterns, reviews, and concrete examples when requested.

featuresSummary.title: Browse translation history
featuresSummary.description: Finds translations the user chose to save.

featuresSummary.title: Offer in-conversation coaching
featuresSummary.description: Adds focused language guidance when VibeLingo coaching is enabled.

featuresSummary.title: Private language helpers
featuresSummary.description: Uses seven bounded helpers for translation, language recognition, corrections, and review.

featuresSummary.title: VibeLingo interface
featuresSummary.description: Adds progress, review, settings, correction, and selected-text translation views.

permissionsSummary.title: Use conversation context
permissionsSummary.description: Reads the current conversation context needed to recognize learning moments.

permissionsSummary.title: Read VibeLingo settings
permissionsSummary.description: Reads the language, coaching, translation, and privacy choices saved for this plugin.

permissionsSummary.title: Save VibeLingo settings
permissionsSummary.description: Saves changes made in the VibeLingo settings screen.

permissionsSummary.title: Use Synergy interface actions
permissionsSummary.description: Opens plugin views and confirmation dialogs from the VibeLingo interface.

permissionsSummary.title: Translate selected text
permissionsSummary.description: Reads text the user explicitly selects before choosing the Translate action.

permissionsSummary.title: Run private language helpers
permissionsSummary.description: Runs bounded language tasks for translation, corrections, and review without exposing them as chat agents.

featuresSummary.title: record-correction
featuresSummary.description: Display and record the exact objective corrections and contextual naturalness suggestions selected by the main Agent. Call this as the first visible action only when the VibeLingo coaching contract requires language feedback.

featuresSummary.title: progress

featuresSummary.description: Show saved VibeLingo translation history. Use only when the user explicitly asks about previous translations or translation history.

featuresSummary.title: suggest-expression
featuresSummary.description: Display how the user's message would naturally be expressed in the configured target language when the user did not write the message in the target language. Call this as the first visible action only when the VibeLingo coaching contract calls for a target-language example. Do not use it for target-language attempts (use plugin__vibe-lingo__record-correction instead), for code, commands, paths, identifiers, pasted text, quotations, or trivial acknowledgements.
